comment: A background subagent's hand-back arrives mid-turn while a send is outstanding. Current claude records it as a queued_command attachment (commandMode prompt) whose attachment-level isMeta is true; the parser classifies it as Role::Meta, like the idle hand-back shape (an isMeta user line). So it is not a human turn: it inherits the active sub-thread instead of positionally consuming the outstanding main-thread send, and the send's real echo that follows still matches it.
